description.summary: Super simple 3-ingredient clean eating pulled chicken made in the crockpot. Sweet-tangy flavor from salsa and balsamic. Versatile for tacos, salads, sandwiches, bowls, or lettuce wraps. Ideal for large weekend batch cooking and meal prepping lunches all week long. Clean, healthy, and endlessly adaptable.

ingredients.ingredient: boneless, skinless chicken breasts or tenders

preparation.step: Add chicken breasts/tenders to the slow cooker.
Pour the salsa (or tomato sauce) and balsamic vinegar over the chicken.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 hours or HIGH for 4 hours until chicken shreds easily.
Shred the chicken directly in the pot using two forks, or for speed use a stand mixer with paddle attachment (1 minute on low after cooling slightly).
Stir the shredded chicken back into the sauce/juices to coat thoroughly.
For weekend BBQ twist: After shredding, transfer to a grill-safe pan or foil and finish on the grill for smoky flavor, or use as base for BBQ chicken sandwiches.
Meal prep magic: Portion into containers for salads, quinoa bowls, tacos, or wraps. Keeps 4-5 days in fridge or freeze up to 6 weeks. Perfect for supporting weekday lunches from one big weekend cook.
